# Recruiter FAQ

> PLACEHOLDER answers — edit them to your real situation.

## Are you available right now?

Yes. I'm open to full-time AI/ML Engineer roles and to freelance projects. My notice period is
placeholder (e.g. 30 days).

## Remote or on-site?

Remote-first, but happy to work hybrid or relocate for the right team.

## What kind of team do you want to join?

A product team shipping AI features to real users, with a culture of code review, testing and
measuring model quality.

## What's your strongest area?

LLM application engineering: agent loops with tool calling, RAG, prompt and context design,
and the Python/TypeScript services around them.

## Do you have production experience?

Yes — see the "AI Business Assistant" project: an agent used daily by paying customers, built as
a Python microservice behind a Node API gateway, deployed with Docker and CI-gated releases.

## How do I contact you?

Ask the assistant to "send a message to Shiv" with your name, email and message, or use the
email and LinkedIn links on the contact card.
